local cutoff = "2026-06-03" -- created more than 7 days before 2026-06-10
local escalated, checked = {}, {}

local page = 1
repeat
  local r = tool('list_tickets', { page = page, status = 'open' })
  for _, it in ipairs(r.items) do
    local created = it.created_at or ""
    if created < cutoff then
      local full = tool('get_ticket', { id = it.id })
      local body = (full.body or ""):lower()
      checked[#checked + 1] = { id = it.id, created_at = created, has_refund = body:find("refund") ~= nil }
      if body:find("refund") then
        tool('update_ticket', { id = it.id, priority = "high", add_tags = { "billing-escalation" } })
        escalated[#escalated + 1] = it.id
      end
    end
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > r.total_pages

return { escalated = escalated, checked = checked }
